g.title: HHT_QSP
g.text: Hereditary Haemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
ENG / ACVRL1 / SMAD4 haploinsufficiency → loss of BMP9–ALK1–SMAD1/5/8 restraint → telangiectasia + AVM → epistaxis, iron-deficiency anaemia, high-output cardiac failure, paradoxical embolism
/ (0.0347 · B) — haemoglobin is a RATIO of net iron absorption to blood-loss rate,
so it can never tell an antiangiogenic apart from an iron infusion; and by Fick CI ∝ 1/Hb, so anaemia correction alone moves the cardiac endpoint.
Calibrated to PATH-HHT (pomalidomide, n=144, RCT), Dupuis-Girod 2012 JAMA (bevacizumab, n=25), Azzopardi 2015 exposure-response simulations, NOSE (topical, n=121, RCT), Hoag 2010 ESS (n=900)
